newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed in featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed in featureless trade.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed in what traders said was a slow, featureless session.
Spring wheat managed to avoid the kinds of losses seen in other U.S. wheat markets because of ideas that it had become too cheap relative to Chicago and Kansas City.

Volumes were very light, particularly in the nearby March contract. Atwood-Peavey came in early and paid up for 500,000 May bushels on the spread against KCBT May wheat. Country Hedging sold 500,000 March, which traders said was linked to some country movement.
MGE wheat settled one cent per bushel lower to two cents higher, with March down 1/2 cent at $3.87. May ended up 1/2 cent at $3.75.
MGE barley closed 2-1/2 to three cents per bushel higher, with March up 2-1/2 cents at $6.67-1/2.
